title: The 5 Biggest Planets by Volume, Ranked (#1 Swallows the Rest)

scenes.text: The five biggest planets, ranked. Number one could swallow all the others at once.

scenes.label: Earth · 1 Earth
scenes.text: Number five: Earth. The biggest of the rocky planets, and the unit we measure every other planet by.

scenes.label: Neptune · 57 Earths
scenes.text: Number four: Neptune. About fifty-seven Earths would fit inside it.

scenes.label: Uranus · 63 Earths
scenes.text: Number three: Uranus. A little more than sixty-three Earths would fit inside.

scenes.label: Saturn · 764 Earths
scenes.text: Number two: Saturn. Seven hundred sixty-four Earths fit inside, and that is still barely more than half of number one.

scenes.label: Jupiter · 1,321 Earths
scenes.text: Number one: Jupiter. Thirteen hundred twenty-one Earths would fit inside it, more than every other planet combined.

description:
The five biggest planets in our solar system by volume, ranked.
Jupiter holds about 1,321 Earths, which is more than all the other planets put together.
Which planet surprised you most?
first_comment: Did you expect Earth to make this list? And what should we rank next?
